issues.description: Function name mismatch: the problem statement and reference solution specify a function named simulate_msd_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float], but the template defines a function named simulate_one_round(...) instead. The template's stub even raises NotImplementedError mentioning simulate_msd_one_round, and the template's helper plot_msd calls simulate_msd_one_round. This inconsistency will cause NameError / unresolved reference errors when tests or plotting helpers call simulate_msd_one_round and will confuse students about which function name they are expected to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Rename the template's simulate_one_round(...) to simulate_msd_one_round(...), update its NotImplementedError message accordingly, and ensure any callers (e.g., plot_msd) refer to simulate_msd_one_round. Alternatively, add a small wrapper in the template: def simulate_msd_one_round(n_shots, p): return simulate_one_round(n_shots, p), but prefer renaming to match the problem statement and reference solution.
